text:
bex: Quick thread — noticed prefix/KV hit% drop for service=embedder-eu around 09:40 UTC. Alert fired but noisy. Where do I start? dash panels, traces, logs? who owns the alert?

sam: Start with the grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv-cache/prefix-hit-rate?orgId=1&var-service=embedder-eu — look at 'prefix_hit_ratio' over last 1h. Also check the 'prefetch latency' panel.

jonah: Logs: grep for `prefetch.miss` in the ingestion logs, e.g.
```
kubectl logs -l app=embedder -n prod --since=1h | jq -r '.message' | grep prefetch.miss | head
```
Traces: use jaeger search for `operation=kv.lookup` and filter by host=embedder-eu.

tia: Re alert owner: it's set to eng-platform oncall in PagerDuty (pd-service kv-cache), but the threshold is pretty tight. We can relax to 10% absolute drop for 5m or add a mute rule for the region during rollout windows.

bex: Thanks. Is there a quick query to map prefixes with high miss rates?

sam: Yes, PromQL:
```
sum(rate(prefix_cache_miss_total{service="embedder-eu"}[5m])) by (prefix) /
  sum(rate(prefix_cache_req_total{service="embedder-eu"}[5m])) by (prefix)
```
Sort descending, show top 20. Panel id is 42 on that dashboard.

jonah: If you find a hot prefix, check recent deploys: `gitlog` in deploys repo or /releases dashboard. Hot prefixes sometimes caused by bad tokenizer changes.

opsbot: Alert: kv-prefix-hit-drop -- service=embedder-eu fired at 2026-03-17T09:42:13Z — slack: #eng-platform. Incident link: https://incidents.internal/redwood/INC-9921

tia: If it's noisy and correlated to deploy, add an alert annotation: `suppress_for: deploy.window` or temporarily increase eval_periods. I'll open a small PR to change alert from 3m -> 5m. Anyone object?

bex: No objections — go ahead tia. I'll run the promql and post top prefixes in this thread. :thumbsup:
